findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: moltbook_read, federation_attest, federation_offer, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Private data: federation_tenant_info, federation_attest, federation_key_status, federation_offer, federation_governance, legal_get, federation_catalog_search_multi, federation_latency, introspection_system_change_reach · Public sink: moltbook_read, federation_pricesheet, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Destructive: federation_catalog_version, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_arena, introspection_system_coverage_gaps.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: moltbook_read, federation_attest, federation_offer, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Private data: federation_tenant_info, federation_attest, federation_key_status, federation_offer, federation_governance, legal_get, federation_catalog_search_multi, federation_latency, introspection_system_change_reach · Public sink: moltbook_read, federation_pricesheet, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Destructive: federation_catalog_version, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_arena, introspection_system_coverage_gaps

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
